subject: Amendment Required: Draft Bill of Lading Discrepancies
body:
Dear Partner,

We have reviewed the draft Bill of Lading against the Shipping Instruction, which serves as our authoritative reference.

Please note the following discrepancies that must be amended to match the Shipping Instruction:
- Consignee: Shipping Instruction = EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC | draft Bill of Lading = UAB NOVAKOPA
- Notify Party: Shipping Instruction = EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC | draft Bill of Lading = UAB NOVAKOPA

Kindly update the draft accordingly at your earliest convenience and provide the revised document for our review.

Best regards,
Shipping Operations
